build_system: npm with next build --webpack, standalone output
test_framework: vitest for unit tests (tests/ directory), Playwright for e2e (to be added)
verification_instructions: 1. npm install, 2. npm run build, 3. Run Playwright tests for multi-user endpoints, 4. Run vitest unit tests
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/9router, 2. npm install, 3. Set DATA_DIR=./data, 4. PORT=20128 npm run dev (for e2e tests)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - full package install access. Node.js v22 available via nvm.
contribution_requirements: Minimize changes to existing files. New features in wrapper/new files. MULTI_USER_MODE env var gates all multi-user logic. Backward compatible when disabled.
key_patterns: Repos use getAdapter() for DB, UUID v4 for IDs, bcryptjs for passwords, jose (SignJWT/jwtVerify) for JWT, NextResponse.json() for API responses, JSON columns as TEXT with parseJson/stringifyJson helpers. Middleware is src/proxy.js exporting from src/dashboardGuard.js. Public paths listed in PUBLIC_API_PATHS and PUBLIC_PREFIXES arrays.
directory_structure: src/app/ = Next.js app router pages/API routes, src/lib/db/ = SQLite layer (driver, schema, repos, helpers), src/lib/auth/ = Auth modules, src/sse/ = SSE/streaming proxy (chat handlers), src/shared/ = Shared utils, open-sse/ = Core SSE lib, tests/ = vitest unit tests, cli/ = CLI tool
